name: smart-memory-plus
title: 智能记忆加
description: Complete memory system for OpenClaw agents. Combines enhanced memory management (WAL protocol, type classification, temporal decay, session cache) with context compression (conversation digests, auto-injection). Zero external dependencies. Use when: managing MEMORY.md, extracting insights from conversations, compressing long sessions, searching memories, tracking task state, or when user says "remember this", "compact", "what do you know about X", "clean up memories".
